headline: Türkiye's Fiber Network Expands 12.9% to 720,000 Kilometers
summary: Türkiye's fiber-optic network expanded 12.9% year-on-year to 720,012 kilometers in the second quarter of 2026, supported by 82,000 kilometers of new infrastructure deployed by telecom operators over the past year.
why: Broadband and telecommunications infrastructure development drives digital productivity, corporate connectivity, and capital expenditure across national telecommunications sectors.

impacts.name: Turkish Telecommunications
impacts.why: Expanding fiber deployment highlights sustained infrastructure investment and network capacity expansion.
